description: Capability for the main window. Only the window controls in the HTML title bar are here: the opener and global-shortcut plugins are driven from Rust (`app.opener()`, `app.global_shortcut()`), which needs no capability, so granting them to the webview would only let the UI open arbitrary paths and rebind arbitrary keys. The updater is different: `updater.ts` drives check/download/install from the webview directly, so it needs its own permission, and `process:allow-restart` is the one command off of it the update banner needs (not `allow-exit`, which the window buttons have no reason to reach).
